seamless_loading_screen.config.title: Seamless Loading Screen Options
seamless_loading_screen.config.display.d: Options relating to how screenshots are rendered during the loading screen.
seamless_loading_screen.config.capturing: Options relating to how screenshots are captured.
seamless_loading_screen.config.fade.desc: The duration, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second), of the smooth transition from the loading screenshot into the ready world.
seamless_loading_screen.config.screensho: New follows the chunk loading percentage. Classic starts a short, progress-independent fade-in. Both are fully visible during Joining world and Loading terrain.
seamless_loading_screen.config.archiveSc: Should old screenshots be archived for later use?
seamless_loading_screen.config.archiveLi: Maximum number of archived screenshots kept. The oldest managed archives are removed after a new one is saved.
seamless_loading_screen.config.updateWor: Should the world icon be updated when you leave a singleplayer world?
seamless_loading_screen.config.soundEffe: The identifier of the sound effect to be played when the transition begins.
seamless_loading_screen.config.playSound: Should a sound effect be played once the transition begins?
seamless_loading_screen.config.soundPitc: Changes the pitch of the transition sound.
seamless_loading_screen.config.soundVolu: Changes the volume of the transition sound.
seamless_loading_screen.config.tintColor: What color should the screenshot be tinted?
seamless_loading_screen.config.tintStren: How strong should the tint effect be?
seamless_loading_screen.config.resolutio:
Native - saves the current game resolution.
Optimized - saves a smaller copy while preserving the current aspect ratio. The game window is never resized.
seamless_loading_screen.config.serverDis: Selects the initial screenshot display mode for newly added servers.
seamless_loading_screen.config.server_se: Options controlling how saved loading screenshots are used on multiplayer servers.
seamless_loading_screen.config.blacklist: List of server addresses where Seamless Loading Screen should be disabled.
seamless_loading_screen.config.saveScree: Will attempt to use the username (if valid) to save the screenshots to prevent multi-user issues
